headers.X-Mishu-Signature: HMAC-SHA256 over the signed input; required for verification
headers.X-Mishu-Event: Webhook event type, for example webhook.test
headers.X-Mishu-Delivery-Id: Stable delivery id; retries reuse the same value

X-Mishu-Signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature. Format: t=<unix-ms>,v1=<hex>. Signed bytes are "{unix-ms}.{rawBody}".

X-Mishu-Event.description: Webhook event type delivered with the payload.

X-Mishu-Delivery-Id.description: Stable delivery identifier. Retries reuse the same id.
